notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Swamps.
description:
Activate the creature with Sword of the Paruns attached using Cabal Coffers's ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
